changes: Qualified existing packed binding kernels for batches of 1,024 signatures on one core at the 128-bit target; full grouping cap 16.
Arithmetic binding uses four packed rounds for one-core batch of 1,024; factored coefficient construction and batched endpoint evaluation enabled with serial execution.
Full binding prepares the first tail polynomial immediately after each integer partition is emitted, retaining separate ring factors and sparse coefficient checks.
Unified integer outer batches ordinary native rounds: four for arithmetic and three for full with 1,024 padded instances on one core at a 126-bit modulus. Other dimensions retain one native round.
Row-round norm cross-product is omitted and the combined middle coefficient reconstructed from the current claim; initial claims remain independently checked.
Native full-Falcon rejection folds use at most 8 KiB Boolean subset tables, with signed fallback for general i16 operands.
Binary lincheck uses delayed reduction and four-lane SIMD with a tested portable fallback.
Joint binder hoists repeated sparse searches outside the repeated-signature traversal.

security_and_protocol.accounting: Existing repository computational grinding model; unchanged field intervals, challenges, degree bounds, grinding schedule, transcript and proof format.
security_and_protocol.proof_equivalence: Every calibration and final proof verified and matched the original pre-change debug proof digest and stored payload size for its workload. Differential tests compare polynomial values, complete proofs, transcript continuations and grinding nonces.
security_and_protocol.native_bound: For row_vars <= 20 and prefix <= 4, norm subtotals <= 2^54 and rejection residuals fit i64.

measurement.cpu: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D; logical CPU 6; SMT sibling 22
measurement.threading: One Rayon worker; main and all auxiliary threads pinned to CPU 6; affinities sampled throughout.
measurement.idle: CPU 6 and sibling 22 each below 2% busy in a five-second precheck; no exclusive OS core reservation.
measurement.samples: One warmup plus five measured trials per baseline/candidate workload; timings are medians; no tracing or allocation instrumentation.
measurement.build: Release, -C target-cpu=native, fat LTO, one codegen unit, falcon-hybrid feature; final binaries exclude bench-internals.
measurement.baseline: Fresh reruns of the original frozen binaries; same seed 42 batch of 1,024 distinct original Falcon signatures.
measurement.peak_memory: Process-wide maximum RSS from wait4, including setup, warmup, caches and all trials; not phase-isolated heap.
measurement.proof_size: Bytes including the 32-byte source root; full payload API gets 32 added, arithmetic already includes its root.

tests.independent_reviews: Integer grid/EQ/recovery and native bounds; Boolean LUT and signed fallback; SIMD gates/bounds; 128-bit reduction schedules; gather ranges. No unresolved findings.

calibration.timings: Diagnostic traces; final measurements above are untraced.

scope: Performance results apply to this one-core 128-bit batch of 1,024 workload. Arithmetic uses the same 126-bit field at 100 bits, so its representation selection also applies there; 100-bit performance was not measured in this campaign.
